chapters.title: Access and fault tests
chapters.description: Set a five-second courier code, then start a test session.

chapters.title: Wrong role
chapters.description: Owner code 1357 cannot open the box as a courier.

chapters.title: Expired code
chapters.description: For this test, the courier code expires after five seconds.

chapters.title: New test session
chapters.description: Restore the 300-second code. This clears the previous session’s event log.

chapters.title: Offline impact alerts
chapters.description: Three impact alerts join the link-loss event: four events await delivery.

chapters.title: Link restored
chapters.description: The endpoint receives the queued events and returns acknowledgments.

chapters.title: Lost acknowledgments
chapters.description: Three acknowledgments are dropped. Retried events count only once.

chapters.title: Owner access
chapters.description: The bolt retracts before the door opens.

chapters.title: Blocked bolt
chapters.description: The test control disables motor force and resists bolt motion.

chapters.title: Locking fault
chapters.description: The two-second timeout leaves the box marked unsecured.

chapters.title: Bolt released
chapters.description: The fault clears after the position sensor confirms locking.
